description: Street map used by Route Evaluation when routes have real coordinates (backend routes). Sample routes without coordinates use the schematic map.
viewNote: defaultCenter [lat, lon] = Lahti, shown before a start/destination is chosen; placeZoom is used when only one place is chosen.
source: OpenStreetMap standard tiles (no key needed; attribution required; fine for light use such as a showroom demo, see the OSM tile usage policy)
